name: bohay
description: Delegate, fork, arrange agents, and organize Bohay workspaces from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate agents and organize Bohay workspaces.
interface.longDescription: Control a local Bohay session from Codex. Delegate work, fork supported agent sessions, arrange panes and tabs, and organize workspaces. Requires an installed Bohay client and a running Bohay session.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a review to the Bohay agent named reviewer.
Fork a supported live Bohay agent into a named sibling pane.
Rename and pin a Bohay workspace without changing its folder.
